title: Shared Snippets
description: Shared snippets stored in /etc/vscode/snippets.json, using the same layout as VS Code's user defined snippets. Each snippet is offered as a completion, triggered by its prefix.

sharedSnippet.title: Shared Snippet
sharedSnippet.description: A single shared snippet, named by its property key.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Typed to trigger the snippet completion. Several prefixes can be given as an array.

body.title: Body
body.description: The snippet's content, one entry per line. Supports the VS Code snippet syntax ($1, ${1:label}, $0, ...).

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what this snippet is for.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Comma separated file extensions / languageIds the snippet completion triggers on, e.g. "rpgle,sqlrpgle".
